City Clerk
About
The City Clerk maintains and updates critical documents, including the City’s Code of Ordinances, legislation, City Council resolutions, and other documents. The City Clerk is also the keeper of important constituent records such as birth, marriage, and death certificates, dog licenses, business permits, and decisions of other boards and commissions.
The City Clerk is the Keeper of the City Records, and the Corporate Secretary for the City. When requested, the City Clerk attests to the validity of City records.
Finally, the City Clerk is the Clerk of the City Council and its committees and subcommittees, creating and maintaining meeting agendas, meeting records, and decisions of the Council regarding permits, grants of location, and other documents.

Birth Certificates
Certified copies of vital records may be obtained either in person during regular business hours or by mail. Mail requests, except as noted below, are filled by close of business on the day of receipt. Fees listed below are applicable to both in person and mail requests.
The City Clerk’s Office has birth records for anyone born in Medford and for most people whose parents resided in Medford on the day of birth. To obtain a copy by mail, send your name and date of birth, a stamped self-addressed envelope and a check payable to the City of Medford. Birth certificates cost $10 per copy, payable in cash, by check, or money order. Please note that Medford only offers long form birth certificates.
How do I obtain a copy of a birth certificate?
You can obtain a copy of your birth certificate from the City Clerk’s Office by mailing a request to the City Clerk’s Office, by visiting the City Clerk’s Office in-person, or at the link below.
A request by mail will be processed and sent out the day it is received at the City Clerk’s Office. You must make sure of four things:
Your check or money order should be payable to the City of Medford.
Enclose the payment along with your written request and return telephone number.
State the birth date and full birth name on the request.
Send a self addressed stamped envelope.
Usually identification is not necessary; however, in certain circumstances it is required, for example, if your parents were not married at the time of your birth.
Please note that access to out of wedlock births, adoptions, and in general restricted records, are limited to the child and the parents listed on the record. To obtain these records, proof of identity (a photo ID) must be provided in-person. In some cases, additional documentation is also necessary. Other persons must have a court order of guardianship to obtain these records.
Please note that any impounded record cannot be mailed. Impounded records need to be picked up in-person at the City Clerk's office.
If you are not certain that a birth record is filed in the City of Medford, please call the City Clerk's office at 781-393-2425 and ask for verification first.
Please DO NOT use the link below to request an ancestry/family genealogy search. If you wish to make such a request, please visit the City Clerk's office or send an email to clerks@medford-ma.gov. Note that there is a $20 per hour fee (1 hour minimum) for research conducted to complete the request. GENEALOGY requests are on a first come first serve non-priority basis. Please be patient as we full fill the requests, office staff will call/email when research is complete for pickup and payment.
Genealogy research birth dates are before the year 1952. Any Genealogy research request that comes in through the online system cannot be refunded if we do not have the documents.
Please note that convenience fees cannot be refunded if the record is not on file.
Request a birth certificate online here: City Hall Systems
Business Certificates
State law requires that any partnership or sole proprietorship, which is using a trade name, file a business certificate (commonly called a “DBA” certificate) in the community where the office is located. The certificate contains the name and address of the business and the names and residential addresses of all partners in the business.
To obtain information on business filings in the City of Medford, call, write or come into the City Clerk’s Office with the name of the business. Please note that business certificates are filed by business name and owner’s name, not address.

Death Certificates
The City Clerk’s Office has death records for anyone who died in MEDFORD or who lived in MEDFORD on the date of death. To obtain a copy by mail, send the decedent’s name and date of death (if known), a stamped self-addressed envelope and a check or money order for $10.00 per copy payable to the City of MEDFORD.
Death certificates are filed in the City or Town where the person died and in the City or Town where the person resided at the time of death.
If you are not certain that a death record is filed in the City of Medford, please call the City Clerk's office at 781-393-2425.
Please DO NOT use the below link to request an ancestry/family genealogy search. If you wish to make such a request, please visit the City Clerk's office or send an email to clerks@medford-ma.gov. Note that there is a $20 per hour fee (1 hour minimum) for research conducted to complete the request. GENEALOGY requests are on a first come first serve non-priority basis. Please be patient as we full fill the requests, office staff will call/email when research is complete for pickup and payment.
Genealogy research death dates are before the year 1952. Any Genealogy research request that comes in through the online system cannot be refunded if we do not have the documents.
Please note that convenience fees cannot be refunded if the record is not on file.
Request a death certificate online here: City Hall Systems
Dog Licenses
Dog owners must license any dog 6 months or older. Licenses are available from the City Clerk’s Office and are valid
from January 1
st
through December 31
st
of the current calendar year. Registrations are open from January 1
st
to March 15th; Any late registrations (After March 15th) may incur a late fee that will be added during the registration process
To obtain a dog license
, provide the City Clerk’s Office the following information:
Owner’s name
Owner’s address
Telephone number
Dog’s name
Dog’s breed, color, and age
Fees:
For a male or female dog, the fee is $15.00. For a neutered male or a spayed female, the fee is $10.00.
You may obtain a license in person, by mail, or through the online dog portal.
Proof of spayed/neutered (if applicable) and most recent rabies vaccine MUST be submitted along with the dog license application.
When requesting by mail provide a self-addressed stamped envelope, check or money order payable to the “City of Medford” and all required paperwork.

Genealogy
Records of vital events occurring before
1952 are generally considered genealogical. Genealogical research is by appointment. Mail requests for genealogical research are filled and completed on a non-priority basis. A research fee
needs to be paid upon completion, Please submit a Check or Money Order to City of Medford for $20.00 per hour of research, plus a self-addressed stamped envelope.
(Minimum of 1 hour will be charged). If you are requesting this through the postal mail, please add a self-addressed stamped envelope for return service. Please be patient as we full fill the requests, office staff will call/email when research is complete for pickup and payment.
Please state the names who need to be researched and mail to the City Clerk at:
85 George P. Hassett Drive
Medford, MA. 02155.
The fee in non-refundable. Email requests will be honored.
Hunting & Fishing License
Massachusetts hunting and fishing licenses are not available from the City Clerk’s Office.
More information is available on the
MA Division of Fisheries and Wildlife website.
Marriage Licenses and Records
To Obtain a Marriage License
Except in limited instances, both parties to a proposed marriage must appear in the City Clerk’s Office to file a Notice of Intention of Marriage. The intention may be filed no more than 60 days before the marriage is to take place. The fee for filing intentions is $30.00. There is a 3-day statutory waiting period between the time the intention is filed and the date the license can be issued. A marriage license issued in MEDFORD may only be used in a city or town in Massachusetts.
Marriage Records
The City Clerk’s Office has marriage records for anyone who obtained a marriage license in Medford, regardless of where the marriage itself occurred. Certified copies may be obtained by sending names and date of marriage, a stamped self-addressed envelope and a check or money order for $10.00 payable to the City of MEDFORD.
Genealogy research marriage dates are before the year 1952. Any Genealogy research request that comes in through the online system cannot be refunded if we do not have the documents.
Please DO NOT use the link below to request an ancestry/family genealogy search. If you wish to make such a request, please visit the City Clerk's office or send an email to clerks@medford-ma.gov. Note that there is a $20 per hour fee (1 hour minimum) for research conducted to complete the request. GENEALOGY requests are on a first come first serve non-priority basis. Please be patient as we full fill the requests, office staff will call/email when research is complete for pickup and payment.
